name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT EVIL TIGA -ACTION-
name.en: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT EVIL TIGA -ACTION-

ja: 清水栄一先生描き下ろしデザインの「ULTRAMAN SUIT EVIL TIGA」が-ACTION-仕様の可動を盛り込み再誕！
■-ACTION-仕様ならではのパーツ分割により、首部の可動範囲を拡大。
■首部、腹部に複数のボールジョイントを設け可動域を大幅にアップ。前屈や腹部のひねりに対応し、臨場感あふれるポージングを実現。
■腹部パーツは可動重視タイプと別売りＬＥＤ装着タイプの２タイプから選択可能。
■清水栄一先生描き下ろしのオリジナル武器やエフェクトパーツ、3種のハンドパーツなど豊富なオプションパーツが付属。
■プラモデルオリジナル武器「イーヴィルフォーク」や「イーヴィルショット」用エフェクトはクリアパーツで再現。
en: "ULTRAMAN SUIT EVIL TIGA" designed by Eiichi Shimizu is reborn with -ACTION- specification articulation!
• The range of movement of the neck is expanded by dividing the parts unique to the -ACTION- specification.
• Multiple ball joints in the neck and abdomen greatly increase the range of motion. It supports forward bending and abdominal twisting, allowing for realistic poses.
• There are two types of abdominal parts to choose from: a movable type and a separately sold LED equipped type.
• A variety of optional parts are included, including original weapons and effect parts drawn by Eiichi Shimizu, and 3 types of hand parts.
• The effects for Plastic Model's original weapons "Evil Fork " and " Evil Shot" are reproduced with clear parts.
